description:
Critical illnesses like cancer, stroke, or organ failure can lead to significant financial stress, aside from the emotional toll.
Critical illness health insurance offers financial protection by providing a lump sum payout upon diagnosis of severe illnesses.

In this video, we have compared TOP 5 Critical Illness Plans in India on the basis of coverage, benefits , eligibility criteria & sum insured. We have also discussed how Critical Illness Insurance is different from Health Insurance.

WATCH THE VIDEO FOR MORE DETAILS :)
